jub.evidence_english: Artist of the SP ballet troupe; corps de ballet dancer from 1 June 1887 after the SP Theatre School.
jub.notes: Рейхель by marriage. 3 Dec 1893, during a performance at the Mariinsky, she nearly fell victim to flames (costume fire) and suffered burns. Died of peritonitis. Named in the ballet season review.
